import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] tree;
    static int size;
    static int[] dp;
    static int[] fact;
    static int mod;
    static int n;
    static int phi_value;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        phi_value = eulerPhi(mod);
        int maxLen = n + 5;
        fact = new int[maxLen + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxLen; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int)((long)fact[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }

        if (n <= 3) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        dp = new int[2000];
        dp[0] = 1;
        dp[1] = 2;
        dp[2] = 2;
        dp[3] = 1;

        size = buildSegmentTree(2005);
        tree = new int[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            setValue(i, dp[i]);
        }

        int m = 3;
        long total = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++) {
            int[] prev_dp = Arrays.copyOf(dp, dp.length);
            long partial_sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j <= i + 2; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= m + 1; k++) {
                    long rangeSumVal = rangeSum(j + k + 1, 2004);
                    partial_sum += rangeSumVal * prev_dp[k - 1] % mod;
                    partial_sum %= mod;
                    dp[j + k] = (dp[j + k] + prev_dp[k - 1]) % mod;
                    setValue(j + k, dp[j + k]);
                }
            }
            m += i + 3;
            long factorialPart = factorialRange(i + 4, n);
            total += factorialPart * partial_sum % mod;
            total %= mod;
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }

    static int buildSegmentTree(int size) {
        int i = 2;
        while (true) {
            if (i >= size * 2) {
                return i;
            }
            i *= 2;
        }
    }

    static void setValue(int i, int val) {
        int idx = i + size / 2;
        tree[idx] = val;
        idx /= 2;
        while (idx > 0) {
            tree[idx] = tree[2 * idx] + tree[2 * idx + 1];
            idx /= 2;
        }
    }

    static long rangeSum(int s, int t) {
        s += size / 2;
        t += size / 2;
        long total = 0;
        while (s <= t) {
            if (s % 2 == 0) {
                s /= 2;
            } else {
                total += tree[s];
                s = (s + 1) / 2;
            }
            if (t % 2 == 1) {
                total += tree[t];
                t = (t - 1) / 2;
            } else {
                t /= 2;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static List<Integer> primeFactors(int n) {
        List<Integer> factors = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) {
            while (n % i == 0) {
                factors.add(i);
                n /= i;
            }
            if (n == 1) {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (n != 1) {
            factors.add(n);
        }
        return factors;
    }

    static int eulerPhi(int n) {
        Set<Integer> p_factors = new HashSet<>(primeFactors(n));
        int result = n;
        for (int p : p_factors) {
            result = result * (p - 1) / p;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long factorialRange(int a, int b) {
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = a; i <= b; i++) {
            res = (res * i) % mod;
        }
        return res;
    }
